scope.purpose: Operationalize ISO 19650-2:2018 5.3.7 by compiling the available pre-appointment information-management components into the delivery team's tender response.
scope.boundary: The tender response is an assembly of distinct governed components. The pre-appointment BEP is one component and shall not be represented as the entire ISO 19650-2 5.3 tender response.

iso_alignment.availability_semantics: Where a component is not available, record its state and reason rather than inventing or silently omitting content.

assembly_process.rule: Establish project evidence for the ISO function compiling the response.
Reference the governed 5.3.2 output and its unresolved/deferred items.
Reference the 5.3.4 aggregate and preserve traceability to 5.3.3 task-team assessments.
Reference the proposed mobilization plan without treating planned activities as executed.
Reference the information-delivery risk assessment and intended management responses.
Record each component as included, unavailable-with-reason, unresolved, or not-applicable-with-governing-rationale where the applicable project arrangements support that result.

conformance_rules.rule: The tender-response manifest shall evaluate all four 5.3.7 component groups.
The pre-appointment BEP shall not be represented as the complete 5.3 tender response by itself.
The capability/capacity summary shall preserve traceability to the underlying task-team assessments.
Unavailable or unresolved components shall remain visible in the tender-response manifest and shall not be silently synthesized.
The compiler shall be mapped to the prospective lead appointed party function through project evidence.
